tests.what: API: login, add two known-priced items, POST /api/checkout, assert order.total == order.subtotal + order.tax and order.tax == Math.round(subtotal*0.08) at cent precision
Rounding: single $1.23 item gives subtotal 123c, 8% = 9.84c, tax must round to $0.10 and total to $1.33 (no truncation)
Multi-item cart with subtotal $19.99: tax must be $1.60 and total $21.59, confirming nearest-cent rounding with no float drift
UI: add items via product cards, open #/checkout, assert [data-testid=order-total] renders the same computed total in $X.YY format

plan.reason: Cent-exact 8% tax math is this case's focus and prone to seeded float/rounding bugs; scope kept to no-discount checkout (discount-tax interplay is a separate requirement).
